title: R1 Neo: GNSS UART validation
description: Enable and validate GNSS UART on R1 Neo. GNSS pins are known but UART is disabled pending hardware validation (ev5b.3). Test NMEA parsing and location submit to HAL.
close_reason: Cannot complete remotely: requires physical R1 Neo hardware validation. Issues: (1) TX/RX direction unknown (Meshtastic=TX:24/RX:25, MeshCore=opposite); (2) AG3335 control GPIOs (vrtc, sleep_int, reset) not documented - only GPS_EN=P1.01 known; (3) NMEA testing requires actual GNSS module. UART disabled in DTS pending this validation.
